name: Omdrop - AirDrop for Omarchy
author: Brent Kearney
description: Send and receive files with nearby Apple devices over AirDrop, on Macs and PCs running Omarchy. Marketplace review lags releases; to install the latest version straight from GitHub, run: omarchy plugin add https://github.com/netmojo-systems/omdrop-plugin.git

barWidget.description: Become visible to nearby Apple devices for a bounded window, receive what they send, and send them files from a radar of who is nearby.
